records.text: Jake Hoffman said Charlie Kirk's memorial was the only event in Arizona history to fill two professional sports stadiums in tribute to an Arizona citizen.
records.speaker: Jake Hoffman

appearances.snippet: Charlie Kirk was an incredible man. He was a friend of mine for 11 years. And when he passed, the memorial we held—it's the only time in Arizona history that we filled two professional sports stadiums to honor and pay tribute to the life of an Arizona citizen. He built a national organization.

verification.notes: The Fox interview and transcript confirm Hoffman made the assertion. Contemporary reporting confirms State Farm Stadium filled and Desert Diamond Arena served as overflow, with roughly 87,000 to 100,000 total attendees. Available reporting does not establish that the second venue itself filled or that no earlier Arizona tribute ever filled two professional venues, so the historical superlative remains unverified.
